cohort: The study included 419 pregnancies complicated with Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA) and 9,096,369 control pregnancies from a nationwide inpatient database.
finding: Women with psoriatic arthritis had significantly higher rates of pregnancy induced hypertension (PIH) and small for gestational age (SGA) babies compared to controls.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in the rates of modes of delivery between women with PsA and controls.
